feature_queries.name: driver_base
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.driverId,
  e.date,
  EXTRACT(year FROM e.date) AS asof_year,
  EXTRACT(month FROM e.date) AS asof_month
FROM eval_table e

feature_queries.name: driver_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.driverId,
  e.date,
  d.nationality AS nationality,
  CASE WHEN d.dob IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(d.dob AS DATE), CAST(e.date AS DATE)) END AS age_years
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN drivers d USING(driverId)

feature_queries.name: driver_history
feature_queries.sql:
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    r.position AS finish_position,
    r.grid AS grid_pos,
    r.points AS points,
    r.laps AS laps,
    r.statusId AS statusId,
    r.constructorId AS constructorId,
    r.date AS race_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  COUNT(finish_position) AS n_races_before,
  AVG(finish_position) AS avg_finish_all,
  MEDIAN(finish_position) AS med_finish_all,
  STDDEV_POP(finish_position) AS sd_finish_all,
  AVG(grid_pos) AS avg_grid_all,
  AVG(points) AS avg_points_all,
  SUM(points) AS sum_points_all,
  AVG(laps) AS avg_laps_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN finish_position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_rate_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN finish_position <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS podium_rate_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN finish_position <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top10_rate_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN statusId IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN statusId != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnf_rate_all,
  ARG_MAX(constructorId, race_date) AS last_constructorId
FROM hist
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    r.position AS finish_position,
    r.grid AS grid_pos,
    r.points AS points,
    r.date AS race_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
), w AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(race_date AS DATE), CAST(date AS DATE)) AS days_ago
  FROM hist
  WHERE race_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN finish_position END) AS avg_finish_1y,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN 1 END) AS n_races_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN grid_pos END) AS avg_grid_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN points END) AS avg_points_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 180 THEN finish_position END) AS avg_finish_180d,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 180 THEN 1 END) AS n_races_180d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 90 THEN finish_position END) AS avg_finish_90d,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS n_races_90d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 60 THEN finish_position END) AS avg_finish_60d,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 60 THEN 1 END) AS n_races_60d
FROM w
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_grid_delta
feature_queries.sql:
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    r.position AS finish_position,
    r.grid AS grid_pos,
    r.date AS race_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(r.date AS DATE), CAST(e.date AS DATE)) AS days_ago
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  WHERE r.date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  AVG(finish_position - grid_pos) AS avg_finish_minus_grid_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN (finish_position - grid_pos) END) AS avg_finish_minus_grid_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 180 THEN (finish_position - grid_pos) END) AS avg_finish_minus_grid_180d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 90 THEN (finish_position - grid_pos) END) AS avg_finish_minus_grid_90d
FROM hist
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_last_race
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_r AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    ARG_MAX(r.position, r.date) AS last_finish_position,
    ARG_MAX(r.grid, r.date) AS last_grid,
    ARG_MAX(r.points, r.date) AS last_points,
    ARG_MAX(r.laps, r.date) AS last_laps,
    MAX(r.date) AS last_race_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  last_finish_position,
  last_grid,
  last_points,
  last_laps,
  CASE WHEN last_race_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(last_race_date AS DATE), CAST(date AS DATE)) END AS days_since_last_race
FROM last_r

feature_queries.name: standings_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    st.position AS champ_pos,
    st.points AS champ_points,
    st.wins AS champ_wins,
    st.date AS st_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN standings st
    ON st.driverId = e.driverId
   AND st.date < e.date
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  ARG_MAX(champ_pos, st_date) AS last_champ_pos,
  ARG_MAX(champ_points, st_date) AS last_champ_points,
  ARG_MAX(champ_wins, st_date) AS last_champ_wins
FROM s
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: constructor_asof
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_ctor AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    ARG_MAX(r.constructorId, r.date) AS constructorId
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), cs AS (
  SELECT
    lc.driverId,
    lc.date,
    lc.constructorId,
    cst.position AS ctor_pos,
    cst.points AS ctor_points,
    cst.wins AS ctor_wins,
    cst.date AS cs_date
  FROM last_ctor lc
  LEFT JOIN constructor_standings cst
    ON cst.constructorId = lc.constructorId
   AND cst.date < lc.date
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  ARG_MAX(ctor_pos, cs_date) AS last_ctor_champ_pos,
  ARG_MAX(ctor_points, cs_date) AS last_ctor_champ_points,
  ARG_MAX(ctor_wins, cs_date) AS last_ctor_champ_wins
FROM cs
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: constructor_grid_strength
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_ctor AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    ARG_MAX(r.constructorId, r.date) AS constructorId
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), ctor_hist AS (
  SELECT
    lc.driverId,
    lc.date,
    rr.grid AS grid_pos,
    rr.date AS race_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(rr.date AS DATE), CAST(lc.date AS DATE)) AS days_ago
  FROM last_ctor lc
  LEFT JOIN results rr
    ON rr.constructorId = lc.constructorId
   AND rr.date < lc.date
  WHERE rr.date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  AVG(grid_pos) AS ctor_avg_grid_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN grid_pos END) AS ctor_avg_grid_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 180 THEN grid_pos END) AS ctor_avg_grid_180d
FROM ctor_hist
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_ytd
feature_queries.sql:
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    r.position AS finish_position,
    r.grid AS grid_pos,
    r.points AS points
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
   AND EXTRACT(year FROM r.date) = EXTRACT(year FROM e.date)
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  COUNT(finish_position) AS n_races_ytd,
  AVG(finish_position) AS avg_finish_ytd,
  AVG(grid_pos) AS avg_grid_ytd,
  AVG(points) AS avg_points_ytd,
  AVG(CASE WHEN finish_position <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top10_rate_ytd
FROM hist
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: field_size_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH recent_races AS (
  SELECT
    e.driverId,
    e.date,
    r.raceId,
    r.date AS race_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(r.date AS DATE), CAST(e.date AS DATE)) AS days_ago
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  WHERE r.raceId IS NOT NULL
), race_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    rr.driverId,
    rr.date,
    rr.raceId,
    rr.days_ago,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results x WHERE x.raceId = rr.raceId) AS race_field_size
  FROM recent_races rr
)
SELECT
  driverId,
  date,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 365 THEN race_field_size END) AS avg_field_size_1y,
  AVG(CASE WHEN days_ago <= 180 THEN race_field_size END) AS avg_field_size_180d,
  AVG(race_field_size) AS avg_field_size_all
FROM race_sizes
GROUP BY driverId, date
